sources.title: GatekeeperZA/RKLLM-API-Server: RKLLM API Server - GitHub
sources.snippet: For NPU reasoning, use Qwen3-1.7B instead — it supports <think> tags, runs at ~13.6 tok/s on the NPU, and works reliably with RKLLM v1.2.3. If you need DeepSeek-R1, run deepseek-r1:7b via Ollama on CPU — it works correctly (just slower, ~2-3 tok/s on RK3588 ARM cores).

sources.title: GitHub - airockchip/rknn-llm
sources.snippet: The overall framework is as follows: In order to use RKNPU, users need to first run the RKLLM-Toolkit tool on the computer, convert the trained model into an RKLLM format model, and then inference on the development board using the RKLLM C API. RKLLM-Toolkit is a software development kit for users to perform model conversionand quantization on PC.
